requirement.description: The artifact dumping functionality fails to properly serialize non-base Pydantic models and returns string representations instead of JSON.
requirement.contract: When saving artifacts with non-base Pydantic models, the serializer should correctly convert the object to JSON format using the defined dumps method or standard serialization instead of returning string representation of the object.

requirement.description: Return type validation fails for annotated dictionary and list types, rejecting actual Python types that match the annotation.
requirement.contract: When a function returns a value with a type annotation like typing.Dict[str, str] or typing.List[str], the validator should accept the actual Python types dict and list that match the annotation, not raise a ValueError.

requirement.description: Artifact loading fails due to incorrect path resolution, causing FileNotFoundError when loading artifacts.
requirement.contract: When loading artifacts, the system should properly resolve artifact file paths to prevent FileNotFoundError.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_input_artifacts[pydantic io artifact input variations-1], tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_input_artifacts[pydantic io artifact input variations-2], tests/test_script_annotations.py::test_script_annotations_artifacts_no_name_or_path[tests.script_runner.artifact_loaders:file_loader_default_path-an_artifact-Hello there!-Hello there!]

requirement.description: Parameter dumping incorrectly handles base model serialization, producing string representation instead of JSON.
requirement.contract: When saving parameters with base models, the serializer should correctly convert the object to JSON format instead of returning string representation of the object.

requirement.description: Byte artifact handling fails due to incorrect serialization/deserialization of bytes data.
requirement.contract: When handling bytes artifacts, the system should correctly serialize and deserialize bytes data using the provided dumpb/loadb methods.
